headline: Quarterly growth was mixed, with a few firms posting strong top‑line expansion while others saw modest or slowing revenue.
summary: Coforge led the pack with 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised its EBIT margin guidance. HCLTech and TCS delivered double‑digit growth and solid margins, supported by AI‑driven deals. Infosys trimmed its FY27 revenue outlook and posted only 1.5% growth, the weakest among the majors. Wipro’s revenue rose 9.1% but profit fell, highlighting margin pressure.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: Several firms reported double‑digit AI revenue growth and AI‑led deal wins.

themes.title: Margin guidance changes
themes.detail: Coforge raised its EBIT margin target; Infosys cut its FY27 revenue growth guidance.

themes.title: Headcount dynamics
themes.detail: HCLTech added 6,450 staff while Wipro reduced headcount, reflecting differing hiring cycles.

Revenue up 9.1% but profit fell 1.9% YoY, with margin pressure.
